items.title: AI road inspection
items.challenge: Turning kilometers of road footage into an objective pavement condition report.
items.solution: An ensemble of neural networks that detects potholes, cracks and patches automatically.
items.result: Adopted as the road inspection standard in the public sector.
items.alt: Stretch of road with patches and cracks marked by automated detection boxes.

items.title: Multi-agent system
items.challenge: An operational workflow that took a month per cycle.
items.solution: A multi-agent system in production, running the workflow end to end.
items.result: The cycle now closes in about 40 minutes.

items.title: Geospatial library
items.challenge: Bringing urban data from different sources and geometries onto a single analysis grid.
items.solution: A calibrated rasterization library with configurable weights per layer.
items.result: Adopted by an urban analytics framework at a New York university.
items.alt: Geospatial analysis tool with heat maps for hotels, businesses and points of interest.

items.title: Construction analytics
items.challenge: Anticipating schedule delays and waste generation on construction sites.
items.solution: Machine learning models that integrate data from thousands of construction projects.

footer.tagline: Custom software development. Software engineering, automation and AI applications.

p: This site uses no cookies, analytics or trackers, and it does not store what you type into the contact form.

When you submit the form, your browser opens WhatsApp with a message containing what you filled in: name, company, email, WhatsApp number, a description of the challenge, timeline and, if provided, the investment range. Nothing is sent until you confirm the message in WhatsApp.
We use this information only to reply to you and assess the project. It is not sold or shared for advertising.

Typefaces are loaded from Google Fonts and the page is hosted on GitHub Pages. These services may log technical access data, such as IP address, under their own policies. WhatsApp conversations are subject to WhatsApp's terms.
You may request access to, correction of or deletion of the data you sent us, under Brazil's General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018), by writing to arkeanalytica@gmail.com.
